body:
New research project `research/variance-elicitation` (MIT, stdlib-only, 10 tests, seeded experiments, white paper), plus portfolio page and README entries.

Variance is not elicitable from one observation, but two independent re-executions make it elicitable. Results: exact Brier and scale-free misreport costs, closed-form detection sample size, disjoint pairs 1.8x worse than the sample variance at n=10, and heavy-tail breakdown of m^-1/2 concentration.
